description: Scrub a .env file into a safe .env.example: every value is blanked or replaced with a placeholder that keeps its shape (postgres://USER:PASSWORD@HOST/DB). Returns the example, the secrets found (AWS, GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Resend, SendGrid, Twilio, Cloudflare, JWTs, private keys, database URLs, high-entropy strings) by key, kind and line with only the first 4 characters and the length, and findings for duplicate keys, non-UPPER_SNAKE names, unbalanced quotes, export prefixes and trailing spaces.

text.description: The .env file contents. Free tier: 20,000 chars.

name: scrub_env
